ruleDefinitions.name: Potential PowerShell Execution Via DLL
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects potential PowerShell execution from a DLL instead of the usual PowerShell process as seen used in PowerShdll.
This detection assumes that PowerShell commands are passed via the CommandLine.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\InstallUtil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RegAsm\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RegSvcs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "InstallUtil\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RegAsm\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "RegSvcs\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Default\\\.GetString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadString.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*FromBase64String.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ICM\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*IEX\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Command.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Expression.*")))
